rounds.gap: secondary applied: broken scripts/config merge recipe replaced with merge_config.sh in both READMEs (the old recipe was a no-op); base.cfg RANDSTRUCT/MODVERSIONS comment corrected (RANDSTRUCT_FULL selects MODVERSIONS on this branch); duplicate-line note added to the boot-log extraction
rounds.detail: Blind pick: winner=B(ours), confidence=high. Critic audited quoted boot lines against the committed merged config (lockdown/init-on-alloc line numbers), verified KASLR strings against the 6.6 source, and validated the differential controls (stock 6.12 boots to sys.boot_completed in the same harness; same-source 6.6 with stock defconfig boots clean past t=173s; fragment kernels crash at t≈10-15s). Loser(A=GrapheneOS origin gki_defconfigs): static input, cannot prove a single symbol live on a running system. The campaign's own finding — the fragment set crashes x86_64 6.6 GKI late boot, bisected to fragment content — is recorded in the artifact, not hidden.

Round 2 (2026-10-08): disk recovered (23G free), bisect infrastructure rebuilt — group configs verified to reproduce the committed crashing config exactly (0-diff olddefconfig check); control re-validation boots started. Live ledger: anvil-cf/campaign2.
Phase 0 (2026-10-08): committed fragment kernel #4 crash REPRODUCED with full console — primary fault is rcuop/2 (RCU nocb offload kthread) dereferencing a garbage callback pointer in rcu_do_batch at t=9.77s (unmapped direct-map addr), then hardened-usercopy abort, panic; the old #DF signature is downstream of this corruption. New control result: pure-stock 6.6 GKI kernel TIMEOUTs at 600s without reaching boot_completed — root cause found in console: vendor early-init waits for /dev/dri/card0, nothing loads virtio-gpu on a 6.6 boot path (6.12 stock loads it from first-stage ramdisk; 6.6-built modules would also fail MODULE_SIG_FORCE). GPU built-in added to all bisect variants; full rebuild of control+GPU variant in progress.
2026-10-08 ~22:20 the campaign tree /home/potato/anvil-cf was deleted by an external disk-cleaner on this machine. Full reconstruction done: kernel re-fetched at pinned commit c905c29016dd; Android CI artifacts re-downloaded byte-identical (build 16373615, same Android 17 pairing); toolchain debs same versions; scripts rewritten identically and now mirrored in-repo (results/cuttlefish/20261008-campaign/scripts). Attempt 002 (control+GPU=y) had proven: GPU live t=0.7s but the image's drm_hwcomposer SIGSEGVs vs the 6.6 kernel and crash-loops system_server (~80 deaths) — open problem documented; GPU-less boot keeps system_server healthy but crawls. All-fragments+GPU kernel (attempt 003) now building.
attempts 000-004 (round 2): GPU-mandatory confirmed on 6.6 (ctrl66 600s timeout, no card0); exact #4 config rebuilt (bit-identical anvil-ref) shows NO kernel crash in 900s — old rcuop/2 signature is build-dependent; new fragment-linked signature: system_server ashmem EACCES at t~93s (no avc); repacker splits initramfs modules (empty /proc/modules); attempt 004 stockgpu control building to discriminate hwcomposer SIGSEGV
